name: mixu-website
description: Mixu (谜序) landing page — bun-only, no framework, no separate lint/format toolchain

scripts.prebuild: bun run render:hero && bun run render:download && bun run render:404 && bun run generate:og
scripts.build: bun run prebuild && bun build --root ./src ./src/index.html ./src/download.html ./src/404.html ./src/en/index.html ./src/en/download.html ./src/en/404.html ./src/ja/index.html ./src/ja/download.html ./src/ja/404.html --outdir ./dist --minify && bun run copy:assets
scripts.check: bun run prebuild && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
